name: Channels
description: wisp.channels: the hub every way of reaching wisp from outside goes through (plan §6.11.3): the channel and notification kinds

settings.title: Accept tasks from channels: messages routed here through wisp Cloud (“on this computer …”) may start tasks. Switch it on at this computer.
Default project: where a task from a channel (Slack, Discord, Telegram, email) runs when its message names none ('': the last used)

commands.title: Send a test to a channel, or to every channel that's on
How each channel is set up (Settings → Phone): on or off, connected, what it still needs; secrets only as saved or not
Set up a channel (ntfy, Telegram, Slack, Discord, GitHub, email): switch it on or off, save its tokens (kept in secrets.json) and settings
Send a notice
commands.uiOnly: wisp's own notices to the user's chats (a finished task, a silent run); a harness answers in its task, never through the user's phone

commands.title: Notify about a task
commands.uiOnly: the runtime tells the user's channels a task needs them; a harness asks with ask_user, which reaches the phone that way

commands.title: Act on a task from a channel
commands.uiOnly: a button tapped on the user's phone, signed by this wisp; no harness holds that signature

commands.title: A message the grid held
commands.uiOnly: the grid's inbox hands in a chat platform's message for this wisp; no harness receives one

commands.title: A message the grid routed
commands.uiOnly: a chat platform's webhook reaching this wisp over the grid's tunnel; no harness sends one

commands.title: Replace a channel's private URL
commands.uiOnly: Settings → Phone's button that replaces a channel's private URL, shown there to copy; a harness never holds the URL
